outcome: Frequency of short interpregnancy interval (≤ 18 months)
cohort: 150 women aged 18-35 years who had experienced a preterm birth and had one previous pregnancy without a history of abortion.
finding: Short interpregnancy interval (≤ 18 months) was observed in 78% of women who had experienced preterm birth.
cross-section timing: The study was conducted over 3 months.
